$comment: The one owner of every GitHub secret and variable the workflows read: its GitHub scope, the local source `bun scripts/workspace.ts secrets push` copies it from, and which release.yml stage needs it. release/github-secrets.ts reads this file for workspace.ts and .github/scripts/release-secrets.sh. scope: repository-secret | repository-variable | release-secret | release-variable (the `release` GitHub Environment) | analyzer-secret (the `analyzer` GitHub Environment) | steam-secret (the `steam` GitHub Environment) | qqbot-secret (the `qqbot` GitHub Environment). local: a config.ini section and key, or a keys/ file (base64 when encoded is set). release: the first release.yml stage that needs it (prepare: every run, release: signed runs), with an optional platform. dependabot: also set as a Dependabot secret when `secrets push --dependabot` runs.

items.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
items.purpose: Cloudflare account id for every R2 bucket and the site Workers; not a secret

items.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
items.purpose: the one Cloudflare API token, an Account API Token: R2 read and write on every bucket plus Workers deploy; release.yml (mod::fetch, release::upload), checks.yml mod lane, analyzer.yml (state and metrics buckets) and deploy-site.yml

items.name: BPP_BUNDLE_SYNC_TOKEN
items.purpose: V6 Bundle Server collection token; analyzer.yml

items.name: STEAM_SNAPSHOT_LOGIN
items.purpose: Steam login that `just mod::steam-login` saves; steam-snapshot-channel.yml reads each Game Assembly Snapshot from Steam with it (docs/adr/0015-steam-snapshot-capture.md)

items.name: STEAM_BETA_PASSWORDS
items.purpose: access codes of the password-protected Steam branches, one JSON object keyed by branch; steam-snapshot-channel.yml reads staging and public_test_realm with it

items.name: QQ_BOT_APP_ID
items.purpose: QQ official Bot AppID; daily-report.yml sends the QQ daily report with it

items.name: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
items.purpose: Tauri updater signing key (minisign): the desktop updater packages and every Managed Payload zip, Android included

items.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE
items.purpose: the BPP Android release keystore (PKCS12) that signs every Android App APK and interop statement; never rotated, backed up offline (docs/adr/0009-android-release-key.md)

items.name: ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
items.purpose: password of that keystore and of its key; apksigner

items.name: ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS
items.purpose: alias of the signing key inside that keystore; apksigner

items.name: APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY
items.purpose: Developer ID Application identity name; macOS codesign

items.name: APPLE_API_ISSUER
items.purpose: App Store Connect API issuer id; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_API_KEY
items.purpose: App Store Connect API key id; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_API_KEY_P8
items.purpose: App Store Connect API private key; macOS notarization

items.name: APPLE_CERTIFICATE
items.purpose: Developer ID Application certificate with its private key, exported from Keychain Access as .p12; imported into the runner keychain
